project_name: MARA/HIF/Starwood Digital Ventures Matagorda digital infrastructure campus
aliases: MARA Matagorda County powered land site
HIF USA Matagorda digital infrastructure campus
developer: MARA Holdings / Starwood Digital Ventures / HIF USA
status_detail: MARA announced a definitive agreement to acquire more than 1,200 acres in Matagorda County from HIF USA for a large-scale digital infrastructure campus; expected grid capacity up to 1 GW by October 2027 and up to 2 GW by April 2028; phased construction expected to begin in 2026 subject to regulatory approvals.
notes: Developer and HIF releases explicitly identify Matagorda County and describe HPC/flexible compute/Bitcoin mining campus. County official and MCEDC sites checked for local context; no more specific county project page found in quick search.

status_detail: Public-private data district proposed on about 520 acres in McLennan County; company/industry reporting describes up to 925 MW planned capacity, while local reporting describes a 1.2 GW dedicated gas-fired plant and ongoing annexation/ETJ issues with Waco and Lacy Lakeview.

project_name: Cipher Digital McLennan / Riesel data center
status_detail: Cipher Digital has acquired land near the Sandy Creek Power Plant north of Riesel for a hyperscale data center; local reporting says plans have been in work under code name McLennan and could use up to 500 MW, with energization discussed around 2028.
notes: County commissioner was approached but no Commissioners Court action found in quick search; project details come from local reporting and Cipher responses reported by KXXV/Waco Bridge.

status_detail: OpenAI announced Milam County as a Stargate site developed with SB Energy; SB Energy later stated OpenAI selected it to build and operate the previously announced 1.2 GW Milam County data center. Industry/local reporting says first phase filings call the project Freebird and construction activity was visible in 2026.
notes: Official OpenAI and SB Energy sources identify county and capacity; Texas Comptroller list includes Milam County Data Center certified 12/09/2025 with MDC Building 1/Orion DC I/Milam County DC entities.

project_name: Riot Platforms Rockdale data center conversion
aliases: Riot Rockdale AMD data center lease
status_detail: Riot announced acquisition of 200 acres at its Rockdale site in Milam County and said the site features a 700 MW interconnection, dedicated water supply and fiber connectivity; the acquisition unlocks the site for data center development, with Riot intending to convert the full 700 MW gross power capacity for data center tenants and signing a first data center lease with AMD.
notes: Company release is official; local news reports Milam County commissioners approved tax incentives for Riot Rockdale data center despite resident concerns.
